purpose: This table holds hourly weather observations for the three New York City area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), combining hourly atmospheric measurements (temperature, dewpoint, humidity, wind, precipitation, pressure, visibility) with static airport reference attributes (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) denormalized onto each row.
usage: Read at the grain of one row per airport per UTC observed hour, keyed by (airport_code, observed_hour_utc); filter or join on these two columns to avoid double counting. Consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir_degrees, wind_speed_mph, wind_gust_mph (null in roughly 75% of rows), and pressure_mb, since these measurements are not always reported.
limitations: The profile cannot confirm grain uniqueness beyond table-level duplicate_row_rate and column cardinality arithmetic; a deterministic measurement must verify (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniqueness against the warehouse. wind_gust_mph is null in roughly 75% of rows and should not be treated as consistently populated. The captured_at column is enumerated though its second-level-distinct, 2026-dated values suggest ingestion or pipeline metadata rather than a weather attribute, despite the profile marking is_airbyte_metadata as false; a reviewer should confirm its intended role. Airport reference columns (name, municipality, elevation, longest runway) are denormalized per row and not independently validated against an authoritative airport reference source.
